name: Canada
tagline: Clear study-to-PR pathways and points-based skilled immigration.
overview: Canada offers structured immigration routes through Designated Learning Institutions (DLIs), Post-Graduation Work Permits (PGWP), and the federal Express Entry system.

pathways.title: Canada Study Permit
pathways.summary: Study at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI) with part-time work rights and post-graduation work permit eligibility.
requirements: Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from a Canadian Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
Provincial or Territorial Attestation Letter (PAL/TAL) for most post-secondary programs
Proof of financial support covering tuition plus living expenses
Clean criminal record and immigration medical exam (if required)
Statement of Purpose explaining study goals and ties to home country

steps.title: Secure DLI Admission
steps.description: Apply to an eligible program at a Designated Learning Institution and receive your Letter of Acceptance.

steps.title: Obtain PAL/TAL & Gather Funds
steps.description: Request your Provincial Attestation Letter through your institution and prepare proof of tuition and living funds.

steps.title: Submit IRCC Application & Biometrics
steps.description: Create an IRCC portal account, upload supporting documents, pay fees, and complete biometrics at a VAC.

pathways.title: Express Entry (FSW / CEC)
pathways.summary: Points-based federal permanent residency system for skilled workers and Canadian graduates ranked via the CRS score.
requirements: At least 1 year of continuous skilled work experience (NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3)
Approved language test (IELTS, CELPIP, PTE Core, or TEF/TCF) meeting CLB 7+
Educational Credential Assessment (ECA) for foreign degrees
Competitive Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS) score or category-based eligibility (STEM, Healthcare, Trades, French, Education, Transport)
documents: Language Test Results (less than 2 years old)

steps.title: Complete Language Tests & ECA
steps.description: Take an approved English or French exam and get foreign academic credentials evaluated.

steps.title: Enter the Express Entry Pool
steps.description: Submit your online profile to receive your CRS score and enter federal draw rounds.

steps.title: Receive ITA & Submit PR Application
steps.description: Once invited, submit full documentation and fees within 60 days.

name: United Kingdom
tagline: World-renowned universities with direct post-study and sponsored work routes.
overview: The UK provides a streamlined points-based immigration system featuring the Student visa, the unsponsored Graduate Route, and the employer-sponsored Skilled Worker visa.

pathways.title: UK Graduate Visa (PSW)
pathways.summary: Stay and work in the UK without employer sponsorship after completing an eligible UK bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree.
requirements: Currently in the UK on a valid Student visa
Successfully completed an eligible UK degree at a compliant higher education provider
University has officially notified the Home Office of course completion
documents: Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) reference number
Sponsor consent letter (if government/scholarship funded in past 12 months)

steps.title: Confirm University Completion Report
steps.description: Wait for your university to confirm to the Home Office that you passed your course.

steps.title: Verify Identity & Apply Online
steps.description: Use the UK Immigration ID Check app and submit your GOV.UK application before your Student visa expires.

steps.title: Receive eVisa & Start Working
steps.description: Work in any role or switch to a Skilled Worker visa once you secure sponsorship.

pathways.title: UK Skilled Worker Visa
pathways.summary: Long-term employer-sponsored work visa leading to Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) after 5 years.
requirements: Confirmed job offer from a Home Office licensed sponsor
Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) for an eligible RQF Level 6+ occupation
Salary meeting the general threshold (£41,700) or applicable going rate / new entrant discount
English language proficiency at CEFR B2 level
documents: Proof of personal savings (unless certified by sponsor)

steps.title: Secure Licensed Sponsor Offer
steps.description: Obtain a job offer from an approved UK employer who assigns your Certificate of Sponsorship.

steps.title: Submit Visa & IHS Payment
steps.description: Complete the online GOV.UK application and pay the visa fee and Immigration Health Surcharge.

steps.title: Complete Biometrics & Receive eVisa
steps.description: Verify your identity and receive digital eVisa status.

name: Germany
tagline: Low-tuition higher education and flexible job-seeker immigration in Europe's largest economy.
overview: Germany welcomes skilled professionals and students via the Chancenkarte (Opportunity Card), the EU Blue Card, and tuition-free public university programs.

pathways.title: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte)
pathways.summary: Enter Germany for up to 12 months without a prior job offer to search for qualified employment while working part-time.
requirements: Recognized university degree or 2+ years of vocational training
Either full German qualification recognition OR at least 6 points on the Chancenkarte points scale
German A1 or English B2 proficiency (if applying via points route)
Proof of financial self-sufficiency (Blocked Account with ~€13,092/year or part-time contract)
documents: Language Certificate (English B2 or German A1)

steps.title: Verify Degree Recognition
steps.description: Check your degree status on Anabin or apply for a ZAB Statement of Comparability.

steps.title: Fund Blocked Account
steps.description: Open a German blocked account showing sufficient funds for 12 months.

steps.title: Apply via Consular Services Portal
steps.description: Submit your application online and attend your local German embassy biometric appointment.

name: Australia
tagline: Points-tested permanent residency and high-demand employer sponsorship pathways.
overview: Australia operates the SkillSelect Expression of Interest system for independent and state-nominated skilled migration alongside the Skills in Demand employer-sponsored visa.

highlights.prTimeline: Direct PR (Subclass 189/190) or 2–3 years via sponsorship

pathways.title: Skilled Independent Visa (Subclass 189)
pathways.summary: Direct permanent residency for points-tested skilled workers without requiring employer or state sponsorship.
requirements: Occupation listed on Australia's eligible Skilled Occupation List
Positive Skills Assessment from the relevant assessing authority
Minimum 65 points on the SkillSelect points test (competitive rounds typically 80+)
Competent English proficiency and age under 45 at invitation

steps.title: Complete Skills Assessment & English Test
steps.description: Obtain a positive skills assessment for your nominated occupation.

steps.title: Submit SkillSelect EOI
steps.description: Lodge an Expression of Interest in SkillSelect and wait for an invitation round.

steps.title: Lodge Visa Application in ImmiAccount
steps.description: Within 60 days of receiving an invitation, submit your full visa application and supporting evidence.
